# Ordered Search: Bag vs Stack vs Queue

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

p5 = require("p5")

// Maze generation and search state
mutable searchState = ({
  maze: null,
  visited: new Set(),
  container: [],  // bag, stack, or queue
  current: null,
  path: [],
  done: false
})

// Structure type selection
viewof structureType = Inputs.radio(
  ["bag", "stack", "queue"],
  {value: "bag", label: "Data Structure:"}
)

// Control buttons
viewof stepBtn = Inputs.button("Step")
viewof runBtn = Inputs.button("Run to End")
viewof resetBtn = Inputs.button("Start Over")

// Hex maze parameters
hexSize = 30
cols = 7
rows = 5

// Generate hex grid coordinates
function hexToPixel(q, r) {
  const x = hexSize * (3/2 * q);
  const y = hexSize * (Math.sqrt(3)/2 * q + Math.sqrt(3) * r);
  return {x: x + 150, y: y + 100};
}

// Generate a random spanning tree maze (no cycles)
function generateMaze() {
  const cells = [];
  const edges = [];
  let id = 1;

  // Create hex grid cells
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let q = 0; q < cols; q++) {
      // Offset for odd rows
      const qOffset = r % 2 === 1 ? 0.5 : 0;
      cells.push({
        id: id++,
        q: q + qOffset,
        r: r,
        neighbors: []
      });
    }
  }

  // Define potential edges (6 directions for hex)
  const directions = [
    {dq: 1, dr: 0},   // E
    {dq: 0.5, dr: 1}, // SE
    {dq: -0.5, dr: 1}, // SW
    {dq: -1, dr: 0},  // W
    {dq: -0.5, dr: -1}, // NW
    {dq: 0.5, dr: -1}  // NE
  ];

  // Build adjacency using Prim's algorithm for spanning tree
  const inTree = new Set([0]);
  const frontier = [];

  // Add initial cell's potential edges
  for (let i = 1; i < cells.length; i++) {
    const c0 = cells[0];
    const c1 = cells[i];
    const dist = Math.sqrt((c0.q - c1.q)**2 + (c0.r - c1.r)**2);
    if (dist < 1.5) {
      frontier.push({from: 0, to: i, weight: Math.random()});
    }
  }

  while (inTree.size < cells.length && frontier.length > 0) {
    // Sort by weight and pick smallest
    frontier.sort((a, b) => a.weight - b.weight);

    // Find first edge to a cell not in tree
    let edgeIdx = frontier.findIndex(e => !inTree.has(e.to));
    if (edgeIdx === -1) break;

    const edge = frontier.splice(edgeIdx, 1)[0];
    inTree.add(edge.to);

    // Add bidirectional neighbor links
    cells[edge.from].neighbors.push(edge.to);
    cells[edge.to].neighbors.push(edge.from);

    // Add new frontier edges
    for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
      if (!inTree.has(i)) {
        const c0 = cells[edge.to];
        const c1 = cells[i];
        const dist = Math.sqrt((c0.q - c1.q)**2 + (c0.r - c1.r)**2);
        if (dist < 1.5) {
          frontier.push({from: edge.to, to: i, weight: Math.random()});
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Sort neighbors clockwise from top (for consistent ordering)
  for (const cell of cells) {
    cell.neighbors.sort((a, b) => {
      const ca = cells[a];
      const cb = cells[b];
      const angleA = Math.atan2(ca.r - cell.r, ca.q - cell.q);
      const angleB = Math.atan2(cb.r - cell.r, cb.q - cell.q);
      // Start from top (-PI/2) and go clockwise
      const normA = (angleA + Math.PI * 2.5) % (Math.PI * 2);
      const normB = (angleB + Math.PI * 2.5) % (Math.PI * 2);
      return normA - normB;
    });
  }

  return cells;
}

// Initialize or reset state
function initState() {
  const maze = generateMaze();
  return {
    maze: maze,
    visited: new Set(),
    container: [{cellIdx: 0, fromIdx: -1}],  // start at cell 0
    current: null,
    path: [],
    done: false
  };
}

// Take one step
function step(state, structType) {
  if (state.done || state.container.length === 0) {
    return {...state, done: true};
  }

  let next;
  if (structType === "stack") {
    next = state.container.pop();  // LIFO
  } else if (structType === "queue") {
    next = state.container.shift();  // FIFO
  } else {
    // Bag: random selection
    const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * state.container.length);
    next = state.container.splice(idx, 1)[0];
  }

  const newVisited = new Set(state.visited);
  newVisited.add(next.cellIdx);

  const newPath = [...state.path, next.cellIdx];

  // Add unvisited neighbors to container (clockwise from top)
  const cell = state.maze[next.cellIdx];
  const newContainer = [...state.container];

  for (const neighborIdx of cell.neighbors) {
    if (!newVisited.has(neighborIdx)) {
      newContainer.push({cellIdx: neighborIdx, fromIdx: next.cellIdx});
    }
  }

  return {
    maze: state.maze,
    visited: newVisited,
    container: newContainer,
    current: next.cellIdx,
    path: newPath,
    done: newContainer.length === 0
  };
}

// Handle button clicks
{
  resetBtn;
  mutable searchState = initState();
}

{
  stepBtn;
  if (!searchState.done) {
    mutable searchState = step(searchState, structureType);
  }
}

{
  runBtn;
  let s = searchState;
  while (!s.done && s.container.length > 0) {
    s = step(s, structureType);
  }
  mutable searchState = s;
}

// Draw the maze
createSketch = function(sketch) {
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  new p5(sketch, div);
  return div;
}

mazeViz = createSketch((p) => {
  p.setup = function() {
    p.createCanvas(500, 350);
    p.textAlign(p.CENTER, p.CENTER);
  };

  p.draw = function() {
    p.background(250);

    const state = searchState;
    if (!state.maze) return;

    // Draw edges
    p.stroke(100);
    p.strokeWeight(2);
    for (const cell of state.maze) {
      const pos = hexToPixel(cell.q, cell.r);
      for (const nIdx of cell.neighbors) {
        if (nIdx > state.maze.indexOf(cell)) {
          const nPos = hexToPixel(state.maze[nIdx].q, state.maze[nIdx].r);
          p.line(pos.x, pos.y, nPos.x, nPos.y);
        }
      }
    }

    // Draw cells
    for (let i = 0; i < state.maze.length; i++) {
      const cell = state.maze[i];
      const pos = hexToPixel(cell.q, cell.r);

      // Color based on state
      if (i === state.current) {
        p.fill(255, 100, 100);  // Current: red
      } else if (state.visited.has(i)) {
        p.fill(200, 255, 200);  // Visited: green
      } else if (state.container.some(c => c.cellIdx === i)) {
        p.fill(255, 255, 150);  // In container: yellow
      } else {
        p.fill(255);  // Unvisited: white
      }

      p.stroke(50);
      p.strokeWeight(2);

      // Draw hexagon
      p.beginShape();
      for (let a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
        const angle = p.PI / 3 * a - p.PI / 6;
        p.vertex(pos.x + hexSize * 0.8 * p.cos(angle),
                 pos.y + hexSize * 0.8 * p.sin(angle));
      }
      p.endShape(p.CLOSE);

      // Draw cell number
      p.fill(0);
      p.noStroke();
      p.textSize(14);
      p.text(cell.id, pos.x, pos.y);
    }

    // Draw visit order
    p.fill(0);
    p.textSize(12);
    p.textAlign(p.LEFT);
    p.text("Visit order: " + state.path.map(i => state.maze[i].id).join(" → "), 10, 330);
  };
});

// Draw the data structure visualization
containerViz = createSketch((p) => {
  p.setup = function() {
    p.createCanvas(300, 200);
    p.textAlign(p.CENTER, p.CENTER);
  };

  p.draw = function() {
    p.background(250);

    const state = searchState;
    if (!state.maze) return;

    const items = state.container.map(c => state.maze[c.cellIdx].id);

    p.fill(0);
    p.textSize(14);
    p.textAlign(p.LEFT);
    p.text(structureType.toUpperCase(), 10, 20);

    if (structureType === "bag") {
      // Circular random arrangement
      p.noFill();
      p.stroke(100);
      p.ellipse(150, 110, 140, 140);

      p.fill(255, 255, 150);
      p.stroke(50);
      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        // Random-ish positions in circle
        const angle = (i * 2.3 + i * i * 0.7) % (2 * p.PI);
        const r = 30 + (i * 17) % 35;
        const x = 150 + r * p.cos(angle);
        const y = 110 + r * p.sin(angle);
        p.ellipse(x, y, 28, 28);
        p.fill(0);
        p.noStroke();
        p.text(items[i], x, y);
        p.fill(255, 255, 150);
        p.stroke(50);
      }
    } else if (structureType === "stack") {
      // Vertical stack (top = last element = what we pop)
      const boxH = 25;
      const startY = 180 - items.length * boxH;

      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        const y = startY + i * boxH;
        p.fill(255, 255, 150);
        p.stroke(50);
        p.rect(100, y, 100, boxH);
        p.fill(0);
        p.noStroke();
        p.textAlign(p.CENTER, p.CENTER);
        p.text(items[items.length - 1 - i], 150, y + boxH/2);
      }

      // Arrow showing pop direction
      if (items.length > 0) {
        p.stroke(255, 0, 0);
        p.strokeWeight(2);
        p.line(210, startY + boxH/2, 240, startY + boxH/2);
        p.line(230, startY + boxH/2 - 8, 240, startY + boxH/2);
        p.line(230, startY + boxH/2 + 8, 240, startY + boxH/2);
        p.strokeWeight(1);
      }
    } else {
      // Horizontal queue (left = first = what we dequeue)
      const boxW = 35;
      const startX = 20;

      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(items.length, 7); i++) {
        const x = startX + i * boxW;
        p.fill(255, 255, 150);
        p.stroke(50);
        p.rect(x, 80, boxW, 40);
        p.fill(0);
        p.noStroke();
        p.textAlign(p.CENTER, p.CENTER);
        p.text(items[i], x + boxW/2, 100);
      }

      if (items.length > 7) {
        p.fill(0);
        p.text("..." + (items.length - 7) + " more", 150, 140);
      }

      // Arrow showing dequeue direction
      if (items.length > 0) {
        p.stroke(255, 0, 0);
        p.strokeWeight(2);
        p.line(startX + boxW/2, 130, startX + boxW/2, 150);
        p.line(startX + boxW/2 - 8, 140, startX + boxW/2, 150);
        p.line(startX + boxW/2 + 8, 140, startX + boxW/2, 150);
        p.strokeWeight(1);
      }
    }
  };
});
```
